Container.Name: HolaClaw
Container.Overview: HolaClaw is a small, stable agent harness. One binary runs an agent that talks on Telegram, Slack, Google Chat, WhatsApp or your terminal, uses tools behind a policy gate, remembers, runs scheduled tasks and drives a browser. It works with OpenRouter, OpenAI, a ChatGPT subscription, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as Ollama.[br][br]This image includes the browser (Chromium), which needs [b]--security-opt seccomp=unconfined[/b] in Extra Parameters for Chromium's own sandbox. Without the browser, install HolaClaw-Slim instead.[br][br][b]First start.[/b] HolaClaw waits for a provider. Open the container's console and run:[br][code]holaclaw init --provider openrouter --token-file /etc/holaclaw-secrets/token[/code][br]It asks for the API key and starts the daemon a few seconds later. Other providers: [b]openai[/b], [b]openai-codex[/b] (a ChatGPT subscription; then run [b]holaclaw login codex[/b]) and [b]openai-compat[/b] with [b]--base-url[/b] and [b]--model[/b] (Ollama on this server: [b]--base-url http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1[/b]).[br]Then run [b]holaclaw check[/b] and [b]holaclaw chat[/b].
Container.Requires: After the first start, run [b]holaclaw init --provider ... --token-file /etc/holaclaw-secrets/token[/b] in the container's console: HolaClaw waits for a provider until then.

Config.Name: Control API port
Config.Description: HolaClaw's Control API, for the apps and scripts. Every client needs a sign-in or the owner's admin token. Over plain HTTP: keep it on your LAN, and put a reverse proxy with TLS in front of it to reach it from anywhere else.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.toml, the agents and channels.toml. A folder only HolaClaw uses: the container changes the owner of its files on every start.

Config.Name: Secrets
Config.Description: auth.toml (API keys and sign-in tokens) and the owner's admin token. A folder only HolaClaw uses: the container changes the owner of its files on every start.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, the blobs and the daemon's backups. A folder only HolaClaw uses: the container changes the owner of its files on every start.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address devices use to reach HolaClaw, such as http://tower.local:8484 or https://claw.example. With it, pairing a device shows a link and a QR code; without it, only a code.

Config.Name: Browser
Config.Description: Lets the agent open web pages in Chromium. Needs --security-opt seccomp=unconfined in Extra Parameters.
